ja: ログイン時にアプリが落ちるだけでなく、ユーザーの保存前の下書きまで消えてしまうんです。
en: Not only does the app crash on login, but it also wipes out the user's unsaved draft.
alternatives: Not only does the app crash when users log in, but it also deletes their unsaved draft.
Not only does the app crash at login, but the user's unsaved draft gets wiped out too.
point: Not only の後は does the app crash と語順を倒置

ja: 分かったのは、サーバーのタイムゾーンが UTC のままのときだけ、このバグが再現するということです。
en: What I've found is that the bug only reproduces when the server's time zone is still set to UTC.
alternatives: What I've figured out is that this bug only shows up when the server's time zone is still UTC.
What I found is that the bug is only reproducible when the server is still on UTC.
point: 「分かったのは〜ということ」は What I've found is that 〜

ja: リリース前にもっとログを仕込んでおけばよかったです。今はリクエストがどこで失敗しているのか分からないので。
en: I wish we had added more logging before the release, because now we can't tell where the request is failing.
alternatives: We should have added more logging before the release. Now we can't tell where the request is failing.
I wish we'd put in more logging before the release, because right now we have no idea where the request is failing.
point: 過去の後悔は I wish + had 過去分詞

ja: 先週のリリース以降、このエラーは3回起きていますが、昨日の夜は一度も出ませんでした。
en: This error has occurred three times since last week's release, but it didn't show up once last night.
alternatives: This error has happened three times since the release last week, but it didn't appear even once last night.
Since last week's release, we've seen this error three times, but it never came up last night.
point: since〜は現在完了、last night は過去形で使い分ける

ja: もしこのバグが新しいライブラリのせいだとしたら、ステージング環境でも出るはずじゃないですか？
en: If this bug were caused by the new library, wouldn't it also show up in the staging environment?
alternatives: If the new library were causing this bug, wouldn't we also see it in the staging environment?
If this bug is caused by the new library, shouldn't it show up in staging too?
point: 現在の仮定は were を使い、帰結は wouldn't で問う
